name: BENCHMARK
holdout: independently generated runs, kept out of mining; [] to skip Step 5
inputs: environment-facing signals: trigger and assumption vocabulary
outputs: observable outputs: event and guarantee vocabulary
events: output predicates that anchor decomposition, e.g. done == 1
horizon: H in G(trigger |-> ##[1:H] event); how long the response may take
h_pre: samples kept before an anchor (setup conditions the miner needs to see)
h_post: samples kept after an anchor (the response the miner needs to see)
episode_mode: split (one CSV per episode, HARM reads them as separate traces) or concat
min_recall: reject candidates below this smoothed recall over the event occurrences (default 0.2; one trigger of a two-trigger region cannot reach a half)
min_gain: reject candidates whose marginal event coverage is below this (default 0.05)
redundancy_weight: lambda in score = gain + lift - lambda*redundancy
max_triggers: stop after this many triggers per event (default 8)
min_lift: extra smoothed recall a trigger must have over the base event rate (default 0)
min_trigger_support: a trigger must match at least this share of the event count (default 0.1)
trigger_onsets: count a trigger match only where it was false at the previous sample (default true)
reset: propositional expression that marks a reset sample, passed to HARM as --reset
max_ass: HARM --max-ass: keep at most this many assertions after ranking (optional)
min_frank: HARM --min-frank: drop assertions below this ranking score (optional)
numeric_clustering: HARM <numeric clustering=...> for bitvectors (optional; default K,10Max,0.01WCSS,><,==)
compound_vocabulary: declare the propositions a single template slot cannot otherwise reach: conjunctions over distinct signals, signal-to-signal relations, sign splits, same-stem sums and edges (default true, see vocabulary.compound)
compound_arity: how many propositions a declared conjunction may conjoin (default 4; an APB bus phase needs four)
max_compound: cap on the conjunction family, shared evenly across the widths (default 64). This is the knob that trades HARM run time for the three- and four-proposition antecedents
edge_vocabulary: declare transitions as `$rose`/`$fell` propositions, alone and guarded by what the environment presents with them (default true)
trigger_candidates: optional explicit candidate list; omit to mine them with HARM
references: hand-encoded reference clauses from the IP documentation, for Step 5
